## 📝 Summary
The MCP tool test did not handle object-type input parameters correctly. Fields with type: "object" were sent as a raw string instead of a parsed JSON object — causing tool invocations to fail.

This fix:

- Renders object-type parameters as a 4-row <textarea> (matching text-type behaviour)
- Validates and parses the textarea content as JSON before submission, rejecting non-object values (e.g. arrays, primitives) with a descriptive error message
